description: Copies a question bank and all of its items into a new, independent bank (editing one never affects the other) in projectId or the key's project. The source is left untouched. This is the one write a public template id is accepted for, and the way to change a template: duplicate it and edit the copy. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

projectId.description: The project (team) ID the copy should land in, as returned by project_list. Omit for the project the API key is scoped to.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank to copy - your own, or a template id from question_bank_list(scope: "templates").

name: question_bank_duplicate
